paperTitle: 2024年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: 近年来，中国新能源汽车产业发展迅速。目前，中国新能源汽车年产量已高达近千万辆，占全球市场份额超过 60%，出口量不断创出新高。中国政府通过加大资金投入和政策引导，鼓励新能源汽车企业进行技术创新，不断提高产品在市场上的竞争力。中国新能源汽车产业的发展不仅有力推动了国内经济发展，也为全球新能源利用和环境保护做出了积极贡献。
reference: In recent years, China's new energy vehicle industry has developed rapidly. At present, China's annual output of new energy vehicles has reached nearly 10 million units, accounting for over 60% of the global market share, while its exports keep hitting new highs. To achieve this, the Chinese government, by increasing funding and providing policy guidance, encourages new energy vehicle enterprises to make technological innovations and continuously enhance the market competitiveness of their products. As a result, the development of this industry has not only powerfully boosted domestic economic growth, but also made positive contributions to the global use of new energy and environmental protection.
